name: What Happened to Squad 7
source:
What happened to Squad 7 is a narrative and gritty military, visual novel with 6 unique endings that reflect your choices throughout the entirety of the story and is based on an already playable text-based adventure game of the same name. 

Play as Orion of Squad 7, a military task unit equipped with futuristic technology that teaches civilians everything required to become a soldier with 10 years of experience, in 10 days. With this technology, Squad 7 is sent into the Southern United States to eliminate a newly attacking alien threat called "Eidolons" which threaten the American way of living, and possibly the world.
